---
title: Quickstart
sidebarTitle: Start here
description: Send your first widget in five minutes.
---

<Steps>
  <Step title="Install the CLI">
    <CodeGroup>
    ```bash npm
    npm i -g acme
    ```
    ```bash yarn
    yarn global add acme
    ```
    </CodeGroup>
  </Step>
  <Step title="Log in">
    Run `acme login`.
  </Step>
</Steps>

<Warning>Keep your key secret.</Warning>
